verses.text: O God thou hast cast us off, thou hast broken us down; Thou hast been angry; oh restore us again.

segments.text: O God thou hast cast us off, thou hast broken us down;
Thou hast been angry; oh restore us again.

verses.text: Thou hast made the land to tremble; thou hast rent it: Heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

segments.text: Thou hast made the land to tremble; thou hast rent it:
Heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

verses.text: Thou hast showed thy people hard things: Thou hast made us to drink the wine of staggering.

segments.text: Thou hast showed thy people hard things:
Thou hast made us to drink the wine of staggering.

verses.text: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, That it may be displayed because of the truth. [Selah

segments.text: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee,
That it may be displayed because of the truth. [Selah

verses.text: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer us.

segments.text: That thy beloved may be delivered,
Save with thy right hand, and answer us.

verses.text: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

segments.text: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult;
I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.text: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.

segments.text: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine;
Ephraim also is the defence of my head;
Judah is my sceptre.

verses.text: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom will I cast my shoe: Philistia, shout thou because of me.

segments.text: Moab is my washpot;
Upon Edom will I cast my shoe:
Philistia, shout thou because of me.

verses.text: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who hath led me unto Edom?

segments.text: Who will bring me into the strong city?
Who hath led me unto Edom?

verses.text: Hast not thou, O God, cast us off? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.

segments.text: Hast not thou, O God, cast us off?
And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.

verses.text: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.

segments.text: Give us help against the adversary;
For vain is the help of man.

verses.text: Through God we shall do valiantly; For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.

segments.text: Through God we shall do valiantly;
For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; set to Shushan Eduth. Michtam of David, to teach; when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, and Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the Valley of Salt twelve thousand.
